meta.title: RFQ: raise by 10 (100 → 110)
warnings: moved open_prepared to the front — every later step acts on that screen
moved open_prepared to the front — every later step acts on that screen

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ with Vendor A at 100 and Vendor B at 90; this is the required starting point for the prepared state.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Ensure the tenant permits an RFQ bid price increase before testing the revision.
Move to Vendor A's separate supplier-portal session while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the prepared RFQ's pricing round in Vendor A's portal.
Revise Vendor A's existing 100 bid to 110 and submit the revised quote.
Confirm the vendor portal accepted the revision and shows the bid as submitted.
Verify the vendor-side RFQ bid price is the revised value held for this case.
Return to the buyer's event page.
Open the buyer's Responses view to verify both vendor responses remain visible.
Confirm the buyer sees responses from both vendors after Vendor A's revision.
Open the buyer's Master QCS comparison grid.
Assert Vendor A's revised RFQ rate is 110 in the buyer's comparison grid.
